summary: Revised implementation plan leveraging direct Drama ID resolution from web_manbo/dramaDetail?dramaId=..., unlocking official LRC subtitles for all locked episodes without authentication blockers, offering multi-format subtitle exports (SRT, LRC, VTT, TXT, JSON, Bilingual), multi-credential session pass-through, and direct media/stream ingestion for audio export in M4A, MP3, and WAV.
